title: Capture evidence collection
responsibility: Reads a check’s capture index and inspects each declared evidence file to build record entries.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.directory
inputs.description: Evidence directory containing the capture index and files it names.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.recordPath
inputs.description: Record-relative prefix prepended to each captured filename.

outputs.name: gatherCaptures
outputs.description: Gathered captures with SHA-256, byte size, current timestamp and initial passed status, plus media facts or parsed benchmark data. Malformed index lines and missing files are returned as failures; no index yields empty arrays.
